reason: A conversational DSH plugin discovery skill that aggregates multiple public indexes, ranks search results, performs limited local static audits, and guides installation and verification.

summaries.zh: 这是一个通过聚合多个公开数据源、语义检索候选结果并进行本地静态审计来帮助用户查找和安装 DSH 插件的对话式技能。
summaries.en: A conversational skill that helps users find DSH plugins by aggregating public sources, ranking candidates semantically, performing local static audits, and guiding installation.

capabilities: Aggregates plugin metadata from public web sources and GitHub
Performs local BM25 and semantic-oriented plugin search
Performs static audits of candidate plugin metadata and README text
Provides installation and post-install verification guidance
